name: Commerce Easy (Nets Easy)
description: A Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Nets Easy (Nexi).
project_description:
Back to top 

 Nets Easy payment for Drupal 
 Nets is among the top payment processors in Europe and keep a tight focus on making it even easier and more intuitive for merchants and service providers to handle digital payments.

 The Easy Drupal extension allows online merchants across Europe to accept payments from cards and from the most popular alternative payment methods. This extension is the fastest and most reliable way to connect your Drupal ecommerce store to our Nets Easy payment service. 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 The Easy checkout is a lightning fast payment checkout offering users full freedom to choose their preferred payment methods:

 
 Conversion-oriented checkout 
 Visa, MasterCard and Dankort cards with auto-save 
 Invoices (AfterPay, Ratepay) for pay later or instalments 
 PayPal 
 Mobile wallets such as Vipps, Swish and MobilePay 
 
 Returning customers are recognized and can pay in a blink of an eye.

The checkout can be embedded in your online store for a total seamless shopping experience.

You can customize the checkout after your needs: you choose the payment methods, the colors of your checkout and which customer input fields you need

 Back to top 

 Security 
 Nets Easy checkout is a PCI-DSS level 1 certified entity and complies with the latest PSD2 and Strong Customer Authentication requirements.

Customer are entering their payment data in the Nets secure environment. The Drupal store will be under SAQ level A.

No sensitive payment data is being entered or stored in the Drupal server.
